packet_gold_stopped_body: Character gold ({gold}) is below the minimum ({minimum}). Packet Trade stopped and the account was disconnected. Replenish gold before signing in again.
autopot_vitals_hint: Enable a vital to monitor it. Assign a hotkey to auto-flask; leave it empty for display-only.
autopot_hotkey_tooltip: Click to bind a key/gamepad button. Right-click to clear (no trigger).
vitals_overlay_shows_enabled: The overlay shows the vitals enabled above.
ac_craft_speed_hint: x1 = 1 click per second, x100 = maximum speed
ac_reroll_timeout_hint: How long to wait for the item's mods to change after a click before re-applying the currency (a miss).
ac_group_logic_hint: OR in group, AND across groups
ac_data_dl_error: Failed to download mod data from server.
ac_instr_step0: 0. Mod data downloads automatically from the server when the AutoCraft tab is opened.
ac_instr_step1: 1. Enable AutoCraft using the checkbox above.
ac_instr_step2: 2. Switch to the game window and open your inventory.
ac_instr_step3: 3. Hover over the item you want to craft.
ac_instr_step4: 4. Press Ctrl+Alt to open the craft setup window.
ac_instr_step5: 5. Select a currency from the dropdown.
ac_instr_step7: 7. Search for desired mods and add them as targets.
ac_instr_step7b: 7b. For hybrid/compound stats (e.g. Life+Mana): add both stats to the same group, then click Link to combine them into a sub-group.
ac_instr_step8: 8. Set minimum value thresholds for each mod.
ac_instr_step9: 9. Click 'START CRAFT' to begin automatic crafting.
ac_instr_tip1: Crafting stops when a target mod is found or the currency limit is reached.
ac_instr_tip2: Press Ctrl+Alt again during crafting to stop immediately.
ac_instr_tip3: You can add multiple target mods - any match counts as success.
ac_instr_tip4: Lower the Speed in Settings if crafting misbehaves on a slow connection.
ac_instr_tip5: Linked sub-groups match compound mods: all linked stats must appear on the same item mod. Order doesn't matter - all combinations are checked.
ac_instr_warn1: Ensure the game inventory is fully visible and not obscured.
ac_instr_warn2: Do not move the game window during crafting.
ac_instr_warn3: Keep the target item in the same inventory slot.
ac_linking_mode: Click another mod in this group to link...
ac_need_mod: Add at least one target mod!
ac_no_mods: No mods added. Search and add mods above.
ac_result_item_not_found: Target item is not in its slot — select it again
ac_running_hint: Running. Switch to game window. Hover item and press 'Ctrl+Alt' to start.
atlas_add_group_tooltip: Create a new custom map group with the entered name.
atlas_add_map_input_tooltip: Type a map name to add to this group.
atlas_add_map_tooltip: Add the entered map to this group.
atlas_anchor_nudge_tooltip: Fine-tune overlay position offset (X, Y). Use to align the overlay with the in-game atlas.
atlas_name_offset_y_tooltip: Raise or lower the map name card relative to the map icon. Positive values raise it. Scales with atlas zoom.
atlas_biome_color_tooltip: Border color for this biome region on the atlas.
atlas_biome_show_tooltip: Show or hide this biome region on the atlas overlay.
atlas_border_thickness_tooltip: Thickness of biome border lines in pixels.
atlas_content_bg_tooltip: Background color for this content badge.
atlas_content_fg_tooltip: Text/icon color for this content badge.
atlas_content_show_tooltip: Show or hide this content badge on atlas nodes.
atlas_controller_mode_tooltip: Adjust overlay positioning for controller UI layout. Enable if you play with a gamepad.
atlas_zoom_tooltip: Atlas map zoom. Applied on release by calling the game's own zoom (only while the atlas is open). Values below 0.85 zoom out further than the game normally allows; a real mouse-wheel scroll reverts to the native range.
atlas_zoom_apply_tooltip: Re-apply the zoom (use after a mouse-wheel scroll resets it to the native range).
atlas_zoom_enable_tooltip: Enable the atlas zoom slider. This injects a one-shot call into the game and is anti-cheat-detectable - read the warning before enabling.
atlas_zoom_warn_body: Atlas zoom works by injecting a call into the game process (a short-lived remote thread that runs the game's own zoom function). This is exactly the kind of action anti-cheat systems look for, so using it carries a real risk of detection and a ban. Use it rarely and at your own risk. If unsure, leave it off.
atlas_default_bg_tooltip: Default background color for atlas node labels.
atlas_default_font_tooltip: Default text color for atlas node labels.
atlas_delete_group_tooltip: Delete this map group and all its maps.
atlas_draw_citadel_lines_tooltip: Draw lines connecting citadel locations on the atlas.
atlas_draw_search_lines_tooltip: Draw lines from your position to search results when filtering maps.
atlas_search_line_color_tooltip: Color of the lines drawn to searched maps.
atlas_search_line_thickness_tooltip: Thickness of the lines drawn to searched maps.
atlas_search_show_distance_tooltip: Show the distance from the screen center to each searched map (smaller = closer).
atlas_search_dist_tooltip: Hide found maps farther than this many atlas cells from the view center. 500 = show all (no limit). Handy for hiding far other-region matches.
atlas_pin_offscreen_tooltip: When a found map is scrolled off-screen, pin its label to the screen edge pointing toward it, so every match (including fog of war) is visible at once without panning.
atlas_draw_tower_lines_tooltip: Draw lines showing tower locations on the atlas.
atlas_enable_overlay_tooltip: Enable the Atlas overlay showing map completion, routes, and badges on top of the in-game atlas.
atlas_grid_color_tooltip: Color of the atlas grid lines.
atlas_grid_skip_completed_tooltip: Skip drawing grid cells over completed maps to reduce visual clutter.
atlas_group_bg_tooltip: Background color for maps in this group.
atlas_group_font_tooltip: Text color for maps in this group.
atlas_group_move_down_tooltip: Move this group down in the list.
atlas_group_move_up_tooltip: Move this group up in the list.
atlas_hide_completed_tooltip: Hide maps that have already been completed. Useful to focus on remaining progression.
atlas_hide_inaccessible_tooltip: Hide maps that are currently inaccessible (locked behind progression).
atlas_fog_view_tooltip: Show only the fog-of-war maps within the screen. Pan toward the unexplored (black) fog to reveal the maps ahead with their name, biome and activities, plus connection lines between on-screen fog maps and dashed exit lines to the revealed maps on the boundary. Revealed maps are not drawn while this is on.
atlas_fog_conn_color_tooltip: Color of the fog connection lines (solid between fog maps, dashed for exits to the revealed boundary).
atlas_fog_conn_thickness_tooltip: Thickness of the fog connection lines.
atlas_access_lines_tooltip: Recolor the connections between maps by availability: green = the map can be entered right now, red = locked (needs a completed neighbor first). Completed maps are ignored unless 'Include completed maps' is on. Fog-of-war maps included. While on, replaces the Fog view's single-color connection lines.
atlas_access_style_tooltip: Solid: the whole line turns red when either end is locked. Gradient: each end is tinted by its own map state, so the border between open and locked territory reads as green fading into red.
atlas_access_color_open_tooltip: Line color at a map you can enter right now (and at completed maps when they are included).
atlas_access_color_locked_tooltip: Line color at a map that cannot be entered yet.
atlas_access_thickness_tooltip: Thickness of the availability connection lines.
atlas_access_include_completed_tooltip: Off: completed maps are ignored — no availability lines are drawn to them (default). On: connections to completed maps are drawn too, with their ends shown green as passable territory.
atlas_ship_reveal_tooltip: Hover an Uncharted Waters ship icon to highlight the territory its Logbook will chart and every map it opens (same color = same set; up to 4 ships share one territory). Hold Ctrl over a ship to keep the highlight while moving the cursor; it clears when Ctrl is released.
atlas_ship_reveal_thickness_tooltip: Thickness of the highlight borders, the island lines and the territory outline.
atlas_ship_lock_key_tooltip: Key that pins the hover highlight while held. Click the button and press a key; Esc disables pinning.
atlas_ship_custom_color_tooltip: Use one fixed color for every ship highlight instead of the automatic per-territory palette (auto: same color = same reveal set).
atlas_mirror_highlight_tooltip: While an item is choosing a map on the atlas (the Grand Mirror of Delirium's 'Select 1 Map' view), every valid target map gets a colored glow so the game's small swirl animation can't be missed.
atlas_new_group_hint_tooltip: Enter a name for the new map group.
atlas_path_thickness_tooltip: Thickness of route lines in pixels.
atlas_remove_map_tooltip: Remove this map from the group.
atlas_route_lines_tooltip: Draw lines showing the suggested route between connected atlas nodes.
atlas_scale_multiplier_tooltip: Scale the entire Atlas overlay. Increase if it appears too small on high-resolution displays.
atlas_search_clear_tooltip: Clear the current search filter and show all maps.
atlas_search_map_tooltip: Type a map name to highlight it on the Atlas overlay. Matching maps will be visually emphasized.
atlas_search_range_tooltip: Maximum distance (in atlas units) to draw search lines. Farther maps won't show lines.
atlas_show_badges_tooltip: Show content badges on atlas nodes indicating available content types.
atlas_show_biome_border_tooltip: Draw colored borders around biome regions on the atlas.
atlas_show_grid_tooltip: Show a grid overlay on the atlas for easier navigation and positioning.
atlas_towers_range_tooltip: Maximum range for tower connection lines (in atlas units).
atlas_search_in_contents_tooltip: A search term also matches the map's content (Breach, boss, essence, effect descriptions...) and its biome name — not just the map name.
atlas_line_mode_tooltip: How found maps are pointed at: a straight line from the screen center, or a route through the atlas maps with a counter of maps to complete on the way.
atlas_route_thickness_tooltip: Thickness of routed path lines (search routes and group routes).
atlas_hop_pill_hint: The «N>» badge near a map = how many maps to complete before you can enter it (0 = enterable now).
atlas_content_mode_tooltip: Show each map's content (Breach, boss, essence...) as icons above its name; hover an icon for its description. «Only hidden» skips maps where the game already draws its own icons.
atlas_content_icon_size_tooltip: Content icon height in pixels (before overlay scaling).
atlas_content_types_tooltip: Choose which content types are shown above maps.
atlas_group_draw_tooltip: Draw a pointer to every map of this group, like the search box. Off = none; Line = a straight line from the screen centre; Route = a path through the atlas edges with a maps-to-go counter.
atlas_group_route_tooltip: Draw a route through the atlas to every uncompleted map of this group, with the maps-to-complete counter. Works for Citadels, Towers or any custom list.
atlas_group_route_color_tooltip: Color of this group's route lines.
atlas_ctrl_click_hint: Tip: Ctrl+Click a map on the atlas to add it to a group.
atlas_hide_non_group_tooltip: Hide every map except those in a group whose 'Draw to maps' is set to Line or Route — an at-a-glance filter showing exactly your group maps.
atlas_picker_hint: Click a group · Esc to cancel
atlas_overall_scale_tooltip: Scales the whole per-map overlay together: map names, cards, hop counters and content icons.
atlas_search_groups_tooltip: Saved searches. While a group is enabled, its terms work exactly like text typed into the search box — matching maps get lines/routes in the group's color. Ctrl+Click a map on the atlas to add it to a group.
atlas_add_search_group_tooltip: Create a new, named, collapsible search group with a multiline query.
atlas_search_group_name_tooltip: Name shown on this search group's header.
atlas_search_group_query_tooltip: One map name or term per line (commas also work). While enabled these draw lines/routes exactly like the search box — distance label, end dot and Distance filter included.
atlas_sg_customize_tooltip: Give this group its own display settings (line mode, thickness, distance, pin-to-edge, property search) for the maps it matches. Off = use the defaults below. Turning it on starts from a copy of the current default values.
atlas_search_display_default_hint: Defaults — used by the search box and any group without its own display settings:
atlas_add_to_search_group_tooltip: Create (or refresh) a search group from this map group — same name, its maps as the query. The search group is where lines/routes get drawn.
atlas_unknown_content_tooltip: This map has modifiers whose ids are not in the local database yet (new game patch). They can be named in Resources/atlas/tokens.json.

autopot_dc_mp_tooltip: MP percentage below which the game will auto-disconnect.

autopot_disconnect_hp_tooltip: Emergency disconnect when HP falls below threshold

autopot_hp_threshold_tooltip: Trigger Key 1 when HP (or ES based on mode) drops to this %.
autopot_key1_tooltip: Click to assign the hotkey for Life/Hybrid flasks.
autopot_key2_tooltip: Click to assign the hotkey for Mana/Utility flasks.
autopot_key3_tooltip: Click to assign the hotkey for Energy Shield flasks. Can be the same as Key 1 or Key 2.
autopot_mode_tooltip: Select the logic that matches your character's defense layers.
autopot_mp_threshold_tooltip: Trigger Key 2 when Mana drops to this %.

autopot_vitals_hp_tooltip: Show Health Points bar in the vitals overlay.

autopot_warn_no_controller: Gamepad key bound but no controller detected
black_screen_select_types: Select file types to remove in Black Screen mode:
bot_click_ahead_tooltip: How far ahead on the path to place the cursor (in world units). Higher = smoother but less precise.
bot_click_interval_tooltip: Minimum time between movement key presses. Lower = faster movement but more CPU usage.
bot_debug_copy_tooltip: Copy debug information to clipboard for bug reporting.
bot_debug_draw_logic_tooltip: Visualize the bot's decision-making logic on the overlay.
bot_debug_follow_tooltip: Make the bot follow the selected entity (debug).
bot_debug_overlay_tooltip: Show debug visualization on screen: path lines, markers, and info panel.
bot_debug_panel_tooltip: Display a panel with detailed bot state, distances, coordinates, and timing info.
bot_debug_path_tooltip: Draw green lines showing the A* pathfinding route to the target player.
bot_debug_scan_all_tooltip: Scan all entities regardless of type filters (debug mode).
bot_debug_stop_radius_tooltip: Draw a circle around the target player showing the Stop Distance radius.
bot_debug_waypoints_tooltip: Show yellow dot for current waypoint and red circle around target player.
bot_disable_in_town_tooltip: Pauses the bot automatically when you are in a town or hideout.
bot_dodge_key_tooltip:
Key used for dodge roll (default: Space).
The dodge roll goes in the direction of the cursor.
Press Escape to clear.
bot_dodge_when_stuck_tooltip:
When stuck, the bot will try using dodge roll
as one of the recovery strategies to break free.
Requires a Dodge Roll Key to be set.
bot_hm_curvature_tooltip:
Path curvature intensity.
0 = straight lines, 1.0 = natural, 3.0 = exaggerated arcs
bot_hm_overshoot_tooltip:
Probability of overshooting the target.
0 = never overshoot, 0.12 = natural, 0.5 = frequent overshoot
bot_hm_speed_tooltip:
Movement speed factor.
0.3 = very fast, 1.0 = natural, 3.0 = slow/careful
bot_hm_tremor_tooltip:
Micro-noise and physiological tremor.
0 = perfectly smooth, 1.0 = natural, 3.0 = shaky
bot_human_mouse_tooltip:
Enable biomechanically-grounded mouse trajectories.
Cursor follows realistic human-like paths instead of teleporting.
bot_max_recovery_tooltip: Maximum number of stuck recovery attempts before giving up and resetting.
bot_move_key_tooltip: Set the key bound to 'Move' in PoE2 settings. The bot holds this key while pointing cursor at the destination. ESC to clear.
bot_move_key_warning: Set a Movement Key in Movement Settings before enabling!
bot_path_recalc_tooltip: How often to recalculate the pathfinding route (ms). Lower = more responsive but more CPU.
bot_pick_player_tooltip: Select a nearby player from the list to set as follow target.
bot_require_focus_tooltip: Only move when the game window is in the foreground. Prevents accidental inputs.
bot_start_follow_tooltip: Start/stop Follow Bot — follows a target player.
bot_stop_distance_tooltip: Stop following when closer than this distance to the target (in world units).
bot_stuck_timeout_tooltip: Time without significant movement before the bot considers itself stuck (ms).
bot_target_name_tooltip: Enter the character name of the player you want to follow.
bot_update_interval_tooltip: Main bot loop interval (ms). Lower = more responsive but more CPU usage.
chk_action_buff_desc: Triggers when a specific Buff is present (or missing) on the player.
chk_action_chain_desc: Triggers another hotkey after a delay, allowing you to create sequences.
chk_action_charged_staff_desc: Triggers based on Charged Staff stacks.
chk_action_charges_desc: Triggers based on the number and duration of specific charges (Power, Frenzy, etc.).
chk_action_es_desc: Triggers when Player Energy Shield percentage meets the condition.
chk_action_health_desc: Triggers when Player Health percentage meets the condition.
chk_action_hold_desc: Holds the key down for a specified duration.
chk_action_mana_desc: Triggers when Player Mana percentage meets the condition.
chk_action_monster_count_desc: Triggers based on the number of monsters within a specific radius.
chk_action_mousemove_desc: Moves the mouse cursor to a specific entity (Monster, Chest, etc.).
chk_action_custom_craft_desc: Starts a Custom Craft config or simulates a key press when a craft starts.
chk_action_repeat_desc: Presses the key repeatedly at a set interval while conditions are met.
chk_action_vitals_desc: Triggers based on Player Health, Energy Shield, or Mana.
chk_add_action_tooltip: Add a new action to this hotkey
chk_add_hotkey_tooltip: Add a new hotkey to this group
chk_chain_delay_tooltip: Delay before chain hotkey fires after the trigger hotkey
chk_chain_tooltip: Fire this hotkey automatically after another hotkey triggers (chain execution)
chk_cooldown_tooltip: Cooldown after the key fires - minimum gap before this action can trigger again (anti-spam). For Hold it starts after the hold ends.
chk_cond_focus_tooltip: Hotkey only works when game window is focused
chk_cond_ingame_tooltip: Hotkey only fires when in active gameplay (not on login / character select / loading screens)
chk_cond_safe_tooltip: Hotkey is disabled while in town or hideout
chk_debug_overlay_tooltip: Show trigger radius and Metadata in game overlay
chk_delete_group_tooltip: Delete this group and all its hotkeys
chk_group_toggle_tooltip: Enable or disable all hotkeys in this group

chk_no_actions_hint: No actions. Click '+ Action' to add one.
chk_no_groups_hint: No custom hotkey groups. Click 'Add Group' to get started.

healthbar_bar_gap_tooltip: Gap (pixels) between HP bar and ES bar when both are shown.
healthbar_border_thickness_tooltip: Thickness multiplier for the bar's border outline.
healthbar_color_bg_tooltip: Background color behind the health bar (visible when HP is not full).
healthbar_color_es_tooltip: Color of the Energy Shield bar fill.
healthbar_color_hp_tooltip: Color of the HP (health) bar fill.
healthbar_color_text_bg_tooltip: Background color behind the health text.
healthbar_color_text_tooltip: Color of the HP/ES numeric text.
healthbar_draw_in_hideout_tooltip: Show health bars while in your hideout.
healthbar_draw_in_town_tooltip: Show health bars while in town areas.
healthbar_enable_group_tooltip: Enable health bars for this entity type.
healthbar_enable_tab_tooltip: Enable custom health bars overlay for monsters and players.
healthbar_graduations_tooltip: Number of graduation marks on the bar. 0 = no marks, 10 = mark every 10%.
healthbar_height_offset_tooltip: Vertical offset (pixels) above the entity where health bars appear. Increase to move bars higher.
healthbar_interpolate_rate_tooltip: Speed of position interpolation (ms). Lower = faster tracking, higher = smoother movement.
healthbar_interpolate_tooltip: Smoothly animate health bar position changes instead of jumping. Reduces visual jitter.
healthbar_rarity_magic_tooltip: HP% threshold for culling strike indicator on magic (blue) monsters.
healthbar_rarity_rare_tooltip: HP% threshold for culling strike indicator on rare (yellow) monsters.
healthbar_rarity_unique_tooltip: HP% threshold for culling strike indicator on unique (orange) monsters.
healthbar_rarity_white_tooltip: HP% threshold for culling strike indicator on normal (white) monsters.
healthbar_scale_tooltip: Width and height of the health bar in pixels (W x H).
healthbar_shift_tooltip: Horizontal and vertical offset of the bar from center (X, Y pixels).
healthbar_show_cull_tooltip: Show a visual indicator when entity HP is below the culling strike threshold.
healthbar_show_es_tooltip: Show the Energy Shield bar above the HP bar.
healthbar_show_text_bg_tooltip: Draw a background behind the HP/ES text for better readability.
healthbar_show_text_tooltip: Display numeric HP/ES values as text on the bar.

radar_category_tooltip: Category for this target (Endgame, Ignore, Acts). Determines how the target is matched.
radar_choose_icon_tooltip: Choose an icon from the icon library for this target.
radar_delete_territory_tooltip: Delete all targets in this territory
radar_editor_draw_path_tooltip: Draw a pathfinder route to this target on the radar.
radar_editor_icon_size_tooltip: Size of the icon on the radar in pixels.
radar_editor_show_icon_tooltip: Show an icon for this target on the radar instead of text.
radar_enable_tooltip: Enable the radar/minimap overlay that shows entities, paths, and map borders.
radar_entity_ignore_tooltip: When enabled, this object will be completely hidden from the radar
radar_error_not_linked: System Error: Radar settings pointer missing. Ensure game is attached.
radar_group_scale_apply_tooltip: Apply the scale change to all icons in all groups.
radar_group_scale_tooltip: Scale multiplier for all icons. Enter a value and click Apply.
radar_icon_mgmt_search_tooltip: Filter icons by name in the icon manager.
radar_icon_mgmt_tooltip: Open icon management to browse the icon library.
radar_rs_currency_tooltip: Currency for the Runeshape reward price shown on the radar map tag
radar_rs_prices_tooltip: Set custom prices for Runeshape rewards the price database can't value
radar_rs_prices_help: Add prices for rewards that can't be priced automatically. Custom prices are used only when the auto database has no price (they never override auto prices) and apply on the radar and in NinjaPricer. Type the exact reward name.
radar_rs_tab_hint: Rune weights rate the monster mods a Runeshape's rune combination applies. Each Runeshape on the map gets the weight of its best possible recipe combination; the radar can draw a path to the highest-weight one.
radar_rs_show_weights_desc: Draw the best combination weight next to each Runeshape icon (green = good, red = bad)
radar_rs_path_enable_desc: Build a path from the player to the Runeshape with the highest combination weight. When you reach it, the path continues to the next-best one
radar_rs_path_min_weight_desc: Build the path only when the best Runeshape's weight is at least this value. -100 = always
radar_rs_weights_reset_tooltip: Community tier list, every monster buff drops extra loot: Opulent/Bond +100, Death/Time +75, Power +50, Oath +40, Soul/Life +30, all other combat runes +20, Bait 0
radar_rs_glow_hint: Label a monolith on the map with a watched rune found on (or rollable onto) a glowing socket. The highest-weight match shows; ties show all. Default rows can be toggled off but not removed.
radar_exp_tab_hint: Explosive-chain route planner for the Expedition league mechanic: reads the detonator, placed charges and targets (monoliths, reward flags, relics), and draws the best bomb-placement route on the radar map plus a 'place here' ring in the world.
radar_exp_auto_physics_desc: Read the map's +% placement distance / +% blast radius, touched-oil count and expedition type straight from game memory - the exact values the game computes. Falls back to the sliders below when unreadable.
radar_exp_manual_total_desc: Total charges to plan for. Shown only when Auto (from game) is off.
radar_exp_price_boost_desc: Rune weights keep ruling the route; this adds a GUARANTEE: a runeshape whose combo reaches the threshold becomes a mandatory stop — the chain is arranged so its reward is always collected, and that combo is the one dug. The pricier the reward, the harder the route holds onto it.
radar_exp_price_boost_min_desc: Reward price in Divine Orbs from which a combo counts as expensive and its collection becomes guaranteed; the pull grows quadratically with price.
radar_exp_finale_bias_desc: Pulls the runeshape with the most rune slots to the END of the chain, so its monster waves fight under the full accumulated buff stack. 0 = off (pure loot math decides). Higher levels accept longer detours and extra transit mines; level 5 nearly guarantees the finale. If the route starts wandering, lower the level.
radar_exp_buff_overlay_desc: On-screen window with the runes monsters will gain from the planned route, in blast activation order. Hover a rune for its effect and your weight.
radar_exp_rune_weights_hint: These weights ARE the Remnant values: the planner routes the chain by them (plus the reward-price priority) and stacks unique glow runes by them.
radar_rs_settings_tooltip: Runeshape display settings, price currency, show/hide hotkey and custom prices.
radar_rs_show_hint: What the on-map Runeshape tag shows:
radar_exp_type_weights_hint: One 0-100 weight per target type. A chest row weighs both the buried chest and the reward flag of that type; logbook flags use the Logbook row; tiny flags are always ignored.
radar_exp_weight_scale_hint: 0 = ignore; up to 50 = grabbed when it's near the route; above 50 = the route bends harder toward it; 100 = a full route anchor, sought like a Remnant.
radar_exp_tw_reset_tip: Restore the recommended default weight for every target type
radar_exp_tw_zero_tip: Set every target-type weight to 0 — the route ignores chests, strongboxes and the other activities
radar_exp_sb_master_hint: The ONE weight for every strongbox: 0 = ignore them all, 50+ = harder detours, 100 = every box becomes a route anchor. The rows below only split priority BETWEEN types — with equal shares every type carries this full weight.
radar_exp_sb_aux_hint: Relative priority of this type: only DIFFERENCES between the type rows matter. Equal values (at any level) = every type carries the full master weight; lower one type below the others to demote it, 0% excludes it. Effective = master x share / highest share.
radar_exp_relic_hint: Upsides pull the route toward a relic (0..100; the monster-juicing mods come pre-weighted). Near 100 the route sacrifices up to 2 extra charges for a relic close to its path, and any mod at 100 makes it a full route anchor. Downsides push the route away (0..-100): a blast pays a penalty for covering it, and at -100 the chain will NEVER blast that relic. Relic buffs land the moment the detonator fires — a relic taken by the very last charge still empowers the whole encounter.
radar_exp_relic_reset_tip: Restore the recommended default weight for every relic mod
radar_exp_relic_zero_tip: Set every relic weight to 0 — relics neither pull nor repel the route
radar_exp_sec_radius_hint: Explosion radii are read automatically from each object (oil 110, faridun 80, barrels 60). The sliders are a FALLBACK for when the read fails - verify with the circles above against a real explosion. Triggered ones always draw on the map.
radar_icons_hint: Customize icon size and type for different entity categories.
radar_path_tooltip: Path (use * at end for wildcard matching)
radar_pf_enable_tooltip: Enable pathfinder — draws A* paths to tracked targets on the map.
radar_pf_global_filters_desc: These filters apply to all areas
radar_pf_ignore_area_tooltip: When enabled, PathFinder paths will not be drawn in this area
radar_pf_multicolor_tooltip: Use different colors for each pathfinder path instead of a single color.
radar_poi_icon_group_tooltip: ID from 'Monster POI Icons' settings (-1 for default)
radar_room_area_unknown: Enter a map first to save a local room target
radar_setting_draw_walkable_desc: Projects the walkable path data directly onto the game map.
radar_setting_hide_bubble_desc: Hides entities outside the network bubble (approx. 1.5 screens away).
radar_setting_hide_pause_desc: Stops drawing when the ESC menu is open.
radar_setting_hide_town_desc: Pauses radar drawing while in safe zones to save resources.
radar_setting_map_color_desc: Color and opacity of the walkable terrain overlay.
radar_setting_show_names_desc: Displays text names above other players.
radar_setting_ingame_zoom_desc: Zoom the in-game camera out beyond the default limit. Enable the checkbox, then set the factor (1.0 = default max, up to 10.0). Writes only to read-write game memory - no code patching.
radar_show_poi_tooltip: Show Points of Interest (POI) labels on the radar.
radar_text_bg_tooltip: Draw a background behind entity text labels for better readability.
radar_tooltip_add_hint: Ctrl+LMB to add | Esc to cancel
settings_advanced_btn_tooltip:
Open advanced automation settings:
stash interaction timing, mouse movement, trade click parameters.
settings_always_on_top_tooltip: Keeps the program window above all other windows. Useful for the overlay and trading — the window does not get lost when switching to the game.
settings_auto_stash_tooltip: Automatically deposit items into stash when inventory exceeds threshold during trade. Requires Memory scanner mode.
settings_active_connections_block_body: You must disconnect all active connections before changing this setting. All connections will be closed and you will need to reconnect manually.
settings_autostash_toggle_blocked_body: Cannot change Auto-Stash setting while trade operations are active. Disconnect all connections first:
settings_block_input_tooltip: Blocks accidental key presses and mouse movements during item purchase.
settings_click_count_tooltip: How many times to click on the item after hovering.
settings_click_retries_tooltip: Maximum attempts to click and open the stash entity before giving up.
settings_cookies_browser_tooltip: Select the browser you copy cookies from. cf_clearance only works with the exact browser that issued it — the trade identity auto-matches your installed version.
settings_cookies_full_cookie_hint: Korean realm (Kakao) only. If live search fails with 401 using just POESESSID, paste your full browser Cookie header for poe.kakaogames.com here (DevTools > Network > any request > Request Headers > Cookie).
settings_cookies_howto_step1: Install Google Chrome or Firefox and select the same browser above — cookies only work in the browser that issued them.
settings_cookies_howto_step2: Open https://www.pathofexile.com/trade2/ in that browser and log in (complete any Cloudflare check).
settings_cookies_howto_step3: Press F12 → Application tab (Chrome) or Storage tab (Firefox) → Cookies → select pathofexile.com.
settings_cookies_howto_step4: Find POESESSID → double-click its value → Ctrl+C.
settings_cookies_howto_step5: Click the Paste button next to POESESSID above.
settings_cookies_howto_step6: Repeat for cf_clearance, then press Check cookies.
settings_cookies_autosave_blocked: Not saved yet: a trade operation is running. The change is applied as soon as it finishes.
settings_corner_density_tooltip:
Lower values detect items easier but may cause false positives.
Recommended: 0.35 - 0.45
settings_cursor_distance_tooltip:
How far ahead of the character (in screen pixels) to place the cursor
when walking to the stash. Lower = shorter steps, Higher = longer strides.
Reduce if the character overshoots or gets stuck on obstacles.
Default: 400
settings_desktop_notifications_tooltip:
Show notifications on desktop even when app is minimized or in overlay mode.
These notifications appear on top of all windows including games.
settings_dn_show_mods_tooltip: Display item explicit mods/stats in notification
settings_dn_show_price_tooltip: Display price and currency in notification
settings_dn_show_seller_tooltip: Display seller's account name in notification
settings_dn_test_notification_tooltip: Show a test notification with current settings
settings_enable_auto_click_tooltip: If disabled, the scanner will only alert you but NOT move the mouse. Use CTRL+LMB to manually teleport to the item.
settings_enable_rate_limit_tooltip: If enabled, the application will respect API rate limits. Disabling may lead to temporary IP bans.
settings_fast_mouse_click_tooltip: If enabled, mouse clicks will be performed instantly without delays.
settings_font_scale_tooltip: Scale factor for all UI text. Increase for high-DPI displays.
settings_gui_fps_tooltip: Render loop frame cap for the POEFixer overlay/menu. 30 minimum, 240 maximum. In overlay mode, your monitor refresh rate may cap effective FPS lower (DWM compositing).
settings_poll_hz_tooltip: How often the background worker reads game memory. Affects radar, health bars, AutoPot, and follow-bot responsiveness. Lower values reduce CPU; higher values give faster reaction.
settings_show_fps_overlay_tooltip: Display a draggable widget with current GUI FPS and game-data poll Hz. Position is saved.
settings_hm_curvature_tooltip:
Path curvature intensity.
0.0 = straight lines
1.0 = natural arcs
3.0 = exaggerated curves
settings_hm_overshoot_tooltip:
Probability of overshooting the target and correcting.
0.0 = never overshoot
0.5 = overshoot half the time
settings_hm_speed_tooltip:
Mouse movement speed multiplier.
Lower = faster movement, Higher = slower/more careful.
Default: 1.0
settings_hm_tremor_tooltip:
Physiological tremor simulation amplitude.
0.0 = perfectly smooth
1.0 = natural hand tremor
3.0 = very shaky
settings_hold_ctrl_tooltip: If disabled, the item will not be bought (for testing purposes).
settings_human_mouse_tooltip:
Enable human-like mouse trajectories (SigmaDrift) for cursor movement.
When disabled, cursor teleports instantly to target position.
settings_language_tooltip: Updates UI text. Requires restart for some elements.
settings_no_game_attach_tooltip: Never look for or attach to the game process. Use this when the program is used ONLY for packet trading — the game does not need to be running or even installed. Manual process selection is disabled while this is on.
settings_manual_process_lost: Selected process closed, reverted to automatic mode
settings_manual_process_tooltip: Select a specific game instance by PID. Useful when multiple copies of the game are running.
settings_max_transfer_tooltip:
Maximum Ctrl+Click actions per stash dump cycle.
Safety limit to prevent infinite loops.
settings_ninja_not_loaded: Currency data not loaded. Load it in Custom Craft Settings.
settings_protected_slots_tooltip:
Items in protected slots will NEVER be transferred to stash.
Click cells to toggle protection. Green = protected.
Protected slots are excluded from the fullness calculation — the stash threshold applies to unprotected slots only.
settings_return_cursor_tooltip: Returns the mouse cursor to its original position.
settings_return_hideout_forced: Auto-Stash needs the session to be at home to deposit, so Auto-Hideout stays on while it is enabled.
settings_return_hideout_tooltip: Sends /hideout after the final purchase result. In packet mode, Auto-Stash runs only when Auto-Hideout is enabled.
settings_scan_timeout_tooltip: How long to keep looking for the item after a whisper is received.
settings_scanner_memory_tooltip: Reads game memory to find items. Faster than image recognition.
settings_scanner_packages_tooltip: Live Search and Manual Buy run over network packets. The program signs in to your account itself and holds the character on its own connection, so no game client has to be running: whispers still go out through the trade site, the session accepts the invite and buys, and auto-stash deposits over the wire. Sign in once under Configuration -> Trade -> Packages; a session that drops can sign back in by itself.
settings_scanner_wgc_tooltip: Windows Graphics Capture. Tries to find the purple frame in the shop.
settings_select_area_tooltip: Manually define the area of the screen to scan for items.
settings_select_area_tooltip_disabled: Launch the game to configure the scan area.
settings_slot_unprotected_tooltip:
Slot (%d, %d) - reserved for purchases
Protected slots: %d/%d
The rightmost 4 columns (4x5 cells) cannot be protected.
settings_stash_full_threshold_tooltip:
When stash tab fullness reaches this percentage, all active purchases will be stopped.
Range: 10-100%. Default: 90%.
settings_stash_open_delay_tooltip:
Delay after clicking the stash entity before verifying the UI opened.
Increase if stash fails to open on slow connections.
settings_stash_refill_below: Top up a pinned currency below
settings_stash_refill_below_tooltip:
Tops up a non-empty protected slot when it contains fewer of the assigned currency than this threshold.
Empty assigned protected slots are filled automatically regardless of this threshold.
At most one source stack is withdrawn per slot during one stash run, so the final amount may not equal the threshold.
0 disables topping up partially filled stacks.
settings_stash_tab_inv_id_tooltip:
Game inventory ID of the stash tab to monitor for fullness.
Default: 133. Change only if your target stash tab uses a different ID.
settings_stash_threshold_tooltip:
Inventory fullness percentage that triggers automatic stash dump.
Counted over unprotected slots only — protected slots are excluded from both the total and the occupied count.
When exceeded, the bot will teleport to hideout and deposit all non-protected items.
settings_streamer_mode_tooltip: Hides the application window from capture software (OBS, Discord, etc).
settings_theme_tooltip: Visual theme for the application interface.
settings_trade_move_key_tooltip: Key used for character movement when walking to stash (must match your in-game Move keybind).
settings_trade_move_key_ctm_hint: Set the game control type to 'Click to Move'!
settings_transfer_delay_tooltip:
Delay in milliseconds after each Ctrl+Click.
Allows the game to process the item transfer before the next click.
skinmesh_empty_list: List is empty. Click 'Scan Metadata' to populate.
skinmesh_select_ignore: Select SkinMesh files/folders to IGNORE (keep visible):
smoother_add_mod_tooltip: Add the selected color replacement rule.
smoother_anim_block_tooltip: Toggle this visual effect. Disabled effects are removed for better performance.
smoother_apply_tooltip: Apply selected patches to game files. Creates backups automatically.
smoother_black_screen_tooltip: Open the black screen fix to remove graphical elements causing visual issues.
smoother_browse_tooltip: Browse for the game installation folder.
smoother_bs_advanced_tooltip: Show advanced options for the black screen fix.
smoother_bs_extension_tooltip: Include files with this extension in the black screen fix.
smoother_clear_backup_tooltip:
Delete backup file and clear stored hashes.
Use this if you want to start fresh.
smoother_export_tooltip: Export current color settings to a JSON file for sharing.
smoother_import_tooltip: Import color settings from a JSON file.
smoother_load_data_question: Do you want to load all data now?
smoother_load_data_tooltip: Load game data files from the specified path. Required before applying patches.
smoother_mm_colors_tooltip: Customize the minimap colors written by the Map Reveal patch.
smoother_mm_edge_intensity_tooltip: Brightness multiplier for the edge color (12x = the default overbright white glow; lower = softer edges).
smoother_mm_edge_tooltip: Color of walls and walkability borders on the minimap. Alpha = opacity of the highlight.
smoother_mm_hint: These colors are written into the minimap shaders when patches are applied. After changing them, apply the patches again for the game to pick them up.
smoother_mm_reset_tooltip: Restore the stock Map Reveal colors (black walkable fill, bright white edges, 0.18 fog floor).
smoother_mm_reveal_tooltip: Minimum brightness of fogged / unexplored minimap areas. 0 = the game's default fog, higher = more of the map stays visible.
smoother_mm_walkable_tooltip: Fill color of walkable ground on the minimap. Alpha = opacity of the fill.
smoother_mod_color_tooltip: Change the replacement color for this mod.
smoother_mod_toggle_tooltip: Toggle this mod color replacement on or off.
smoother_mods_colors_tooltip: Open mod color customization to change spell/effect colors.
smoother_new_color_tooltip: Select a replacement color for the filtered spell effects.
smoother_patch_tooltip: Enable or disable this game patch.
smoother_path_tooltip: Path to the game installation folder.
smoother_restore_tooltip: Restores original game files from backup (clean slate).
smoother_result_success_text: Game files have been modified. You can now launch the game.
smoother_skinmesh_btn_tooltip: Open SkinMesh settings to configure which 3D models are hidden.
smoother_skinmesh_filter_tooltip: Filter the model tree by name to find specific models.
smoother_skinmesh_node_tooltip: Toggle visibility of this 3D model. Unchecked = hidden in-game.
smoother_spell_effects_tooltip: Open spell effects manager to disable specific visual effects.
smoother_spells_load_tooltip: Load spell effect definitions from game data.
smoother_steam_path_hint: Steam version path: SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Path of Exile 2\Bundles2\_.index.bin
smoother_update_desc: The game's _.index.bin file has changed since your last patch. This usually means the game was updated.
smoother_update_note: Note: Clicking 'No' will apply patches anyway without updating the backup.
smoother_update_question: Do you want to create a new backup from the current game files?
smoother_warning_poe2_text: You are in 'PoE 2' mode, but the file path does NOT appear to be 'Path of Exile 2'.
smoother_zoom_tooltip: Zoom level for the effect preview.
telemetry_cpu_too_long: CPU string is {0} chars; the field holds {1} - it will be truncated.
telemetry_explain: The area-transition-ack carries a client diagnostic report naming the GPU, monitor and CPU. With no game client running there is nothing to capture one from, so the built-in fallback would report the SAME foreign hardware every session. Pick what it reports.
telemetry_explain_strings: Only those strings are substituted - the numeric fields are left as captured, because their layout is not fully mapped and a wrong value there is worse than a real one.
telemetry_passthrough_warning: Passthrough: sessions with no game client report the built-in report's hardware.
tl_confirm_clear_all: Clear all statistics? This cannot be undone.
tl_confirm_clear_day: Clear daily statistics? This cannot be undone.
tl_confirm_clear_logs: Delete all trade logs? This cannot be undone.
tl_confirm_clear_url: Clear URL statistics? This cannot be undone.
tl_copy_seller: Click to copy the seller name
tl_force_teleport_tooltip: Force teleport: the whisper carried continue=true (teleported past the competition)
tl_timing_partial: Partial trace — some stages were measured elsewhere
tl_timing_unavailable: No timing recorded for this purchase
toast_upgrade_failed: Could not open the upgrade page — try again in a moment.
toast_upgrade_pending: You already have an unpaid upgrade order — check your email for the payment link.
toast_upgrade_unavailable: Upgrades are not available right now.
trade_add_link_tooltip: Add this trade link to the active connections list.
trade_autoreconnect_tooltip: Automatically reconnect if the trade WebSocket connection drops.
trade_button_manual_buy_tooltip: Manually trigger the buying process for all items in this search.
trade_add_search_invalid_url: Could not add — paste a full official trade site search URL.
trade_add_search_tooltip: Add a new trade search (opens a small form). The + on a group header adds straight into that group.
trade_button_start_tooltip: Start this live search. New listings that match the search stream in and are whispered / bought according to your settings.
trade_button_stop_tooltip: Stop this live search (also cancels its automatic reconnect).
trade_ext_chip_tooltip: Browser-extension connection status. Manage it in Settings -> Trade.
trade_group_add_search_tooltip: Add a new search directly into this group.
trade_group_empty_hint: Empty group — add a search with the + button in this header, or right-click a search name to move it here.
trade_group_new_tooltip: Create a search group. Each group gets its own collapsible section with one-click Start/Stop for every search inside.
trade_group_rename_tooltip: Rename this group (updates every search in it).
trade_group_start_tooltip: Start every stopped search in this group.
trade_group_stop_tooltip: Stop every running search in this group.
trade_timing_none_tooltip: No completed purchase on this search yet this session. After the next buy attempt the full-cycle time appears here; hover it for the per-stage breakdown.
trade_currency_filter_tooltip: Include/exclude this currency type from trade results.
trade_currency_max_tooltip: Maximum quantity of this currency (0 = unlimited).
trade_currency_min_tooltip: Minimum quantity of this currency to trigger a notification.
trade_currency_tab_modal_text: No currency source tab is configured. Add one in Settings -> Protected Inventory -> Currency Source Tabs.
trade_item_count_tooltip: Number of items to buy per whisper (bulk trade quantity).
trade_modal_live_search_blocks_manual_bu: Active Live Search connections must be disconnected first:
trade_modal_manual_buy_blocks_live_searc: Active Manual Buy operations must finish first:
trade_ninja_data_modal_text: Currency data from poe.ninja is not loaded. Please load it in Custom Craft Settings.
trade_no_connections_poe2: No POE2 searches yet. Click the + button above to add one.
trade_note_tooltip: Enter a note/description for the trade link.
trade_stat_bought_tooltip: Bought — purchases confirmed in-game (the item actually arrived in your inventory).
trade_stat_demand_tooltip: In demand — the final whisper response was rejected because of competition for the item. A retry that succeeds counts as bought/failed instead.
trade_stat_failed_tooltip: Failed — the whisper was rejected/failed, or the in-game purchase did not complete.
trade_stat_limit_tooltip: Spend limit usage — the highest fill percentage among the spend-limit rules that apply to this connection.
trade_stat_travel_tooltip: Travel — successful whispers that teleported you to the seller (same-tab batch items processed without a new whisper count here too).
trade_stash_destination_hint: Where bought items are deposited. Guild Stash requires the guild stash to be placed in your hideout. Each stash keeps its own list of target tabs.
trade_target_stash_tabs_warn:
Tab List must be visible!
Target tabs must NOT be inside folders!
trade_currency_source_tabs_hint: (stash tabs to pull currency from, in order)
trade_url_tooltip: Paste a trade website live-search URL to monitor.
trade_whisper_delay_ms_tooltip: Delay between whisper messages in milliseconds.
trade_whisper_delay_tooltip: Add a delay between whisper messages to avoid rate limiting.
uiexplorer_no_address: GameUI Address not found. Game may not be in InGameState.
vitals_overlay_enable_tooltip: Display HP/ES/MP overlay in game. Open menu (INSERT) to drag and reposition.
vitals_overlay_numeric_tooltip: Display current/max values instead of percentages (e.g. 1500/3000)
ws_settings_auto_reconnect_tooltip: Attempt to restore connection if dropped (Max 5 retries).
ws_settings_currency_filters_desc:
Only buy items if the price matches these criteria.
Unchecked = Buy Any Price.
trade_ext_handled_by_extension: Handled by the browser extension in Extension mode
trade_ext_restart_note: Stop and Start the bridge to apply the new key / bind address.
trade_ext_notready_wrongkey: Extension rejected: wrong or missing pairing key.
trade_ext_newer: Extension newer than client — update POEFixer
trade_ext_update_modal_body: Your POEFixer Trade Bridge browser extension is out of date and buying is disabled. Reinstall the latest extension (Settings -> Trade -> Assisted install) and reload it.
trade_ext_assisted_install_hint: Stages the extension, copies its path, and opens the install guide. You finish the last 2-3 clicks in the browser.
trade_ext_notready_bridge_stopped: The extension bridge is stopped, so the browser extension cannot connect. Start the bridge — the extension connects automatically.
trade_ext_notready_not_installed: The browser extension has never connected on this PC — most likely it is not installed yet. Open Configuration → Trade and use "Assisted install…" to set it up.
trade_ext_notready_not_connected: The extension is installed but not connected right now. Make sure the browser is running and the PoeFixer extension is enabled — it reconnects automatically.
trade_ext_notready_ready: Extension connected — you can start now.
trade_agent_apply_failed: The bridge could not be restarted, so the new settings are NOT in effect and the agent is disconnected. The address or the pairing key may be unusable - check both, then press Start bridge.
trade_agent_apply_tooltip: Restart the bridge so the key and address you just changed take effect. Until you do, this program keeps using the previous ones on the link it already has.
trade_agent_code_noaddr: Enter the agent's address first - the pairing code carries that address, so it cannot be built without one.
trade_agent_code_nokey: No pairing key yet. Press Generate above; agent mode needs one, because the trade session is only ever sent over an encrypted link.
trade_agent_code_tooltip: One string carrying the agent's address, its port and the pairing key. Copy it and paste it into the installer on the agent host when it asks. Generating a new key invalidates it.
trade_agent_dial_tooltip: The address of the machine running the agent - the VPS this program connects out to. Use "host" or "host:port"; without a port it is 47362. Prefer a DNS name over a bare IP: it survives a VPS rebuild without re-pairing. Until this is set, no pairing code can be made.
trade_agent_evicted: Another POEFixer instance took over this agent. One agent serves one desktop at a time. Press Reconnect to take it back.
trade_agent_install_hint: Paste the pairing code when it asks. Afterwards, run "pfx" on that host to manage the agent.
trade_agent_install_tooltip: Run this on your Linux host. It installs the agent as a service and asks for the pairing code at the end - so the key is typed at the prompt instead of landing in shell history. The agent then waits for this program to connect to it.
trade_agent_key_regen_note: Generating a new key invalidates the pairing code already on the agent host - re-pair it afterwards.
trade_agent_keyrefused: The agent refused the pairing key. Copy a fresh pairing code and run the installer again on the agent host, or run "pfx pair" there.
trade_agent_notagent: {addr} answered, but it is not a POEFixer agent - check the address and the port.
trade_agent_notready_never: No agent has been paired yet. Install it on your Linux host with the one-liner in Trade -> Settings and paste the pairing code when it asks.
trade_agent_notready_not_connected: The remote agent is not connected. Check that it is running on its host ("pfx status"), that the address entered here is right, and that inbound TCP on the bridge port is allowed both on that host and in your hosting provider's firewall panel.
trade_agent_outdated: The remote agent is out of date - buying is disabled. Run "pfx update" on the agent host.
trade_agent_refused: This agent was refused - it reported the wrong client kind or version. Fix that on the agent host, then press Reconnect.
trade_agent_sha_tooltip: The released agent binary's checksum, shipped inside this program - a different channel than the script. Compare it with the BINARY_SHA256 line inside the downloaded install.sh: matching values mean the script names the binary we released. If the version differs from the current release, this program shipped before it and the values differ legitimately.
trade_agent_unreachable: Cannot reach {addr}. The agent may not be running, a firewall on its host or in your hosting provider's panel may be blocking inbound TCP on that port, or it is an old agent (v1.1.x) that has to be re-installed.
trade_item_in_demand: Item is in demand, teleport anyway!
trade_item_in_demand_tooltip: If a whisper comes back "in demand" (success:false), re-send it so you still get teleported. Safe — this just mimics the trade site's "Teleport anyway?" button.
trade_item_in_demand_forced_off: Disabled while Force teleport is on — the first whisper already carries continue=true, so there is nothing left to retry.
trade_force_teleport_tooltip: Adds continue=true to the whisper to teleport even when another buyer already triggered it. VERY HIGH BAN RISK. The choice is saved between sessions — the responsibility is entirely yours.
trade_force_teleport_warning: Enabling this feature teleports you while ignoring the competition, but with a 99% chance you will get a permanent, unrecoverable account ban! Instead of this feature I recommend enabling "Item is in demand, teleport anyway!" — slower, but safer!
trade_auto_login_tooltip: After a forced disconnect (a loading screen hung for over 2 minutes) or a kick to the lobby, automatically click "Log In" then "Play" to get back in game and resume trading. If disabled, trading pauses and waits for you to log in manually.
trade_loading_hang_tooltip: If a loading screen stays up continuously this long, the client is force-disconnected and re-logs in. Measures time on the loading screen only — it cannot tell a stuck load from a slow one, so a value that is too low can cause false disconnects on legitimately slow loads. Default 120s.
trade_debug_simulate_tooltip: TEST ONLY. As soon as a trade teleport begins, immediately force a disconnect to exercise the full recovery path (disconnect -> lobby -> re-login -> resume). One-shot: fires once, then turns itself off. Never saved.
trade_debug_simulate_warning: Debug mode: the next trade teleport will trigger an immediate self-disconnect to test AFK recovery.
trade_reconnect_enable_tooltip: If the account session drops, sign in again and resume trading. Never runs while items are being deposited.
trade_reconnect_attempts_tooltip: How many times to sign in again before giving up. The budget resets once a session is live.
trade_reconnect_backoff_tooltip: Delay before each sign-in attempt. Too short and a server-side problem is hit repeatedly.
packet_no_buy_return_tooltip: Total time from entering the seller: wait for the offer, make up to 5 packet-driven attempts from incoming data, and confirm delivery. On expiry the purchase is failed; return home occurs only when its checkbox is enabled.
trade_safety_resume_tooltip: Clear the safety stop and allow trade processing again. Make sure the cause is fixed first (e.g. stash space freed up).
trade_safety_reason_stash_cursor_held: an item was left held on the cursor — put it down in game, then press Resume
trade_safety_reason_stash_full: stash is full — free up space, then press Resume
trade_safety_reason_stash_no_usable_tab: no stash tab would take the items — freeing space may not be the fix; the log names which tab and why
trade_safety_reason_currency_stuck: a conflicting item is stuck in the currency slot — resolve it, then press Resume
trade_safety_reason_packet_missing: a packet needed to stash is not known yet — the log names which one
trade_safety_reason_packet_no_effect: a stash action had no effect on the wire — the log names which one
trade_safety_reason_process_switch: game process switched — press Resume when ready
trade_safety_reason_relogin_failed: automatic re-login kept failing — check the game client, then press Resume
trade_safety_reason_emergency_dc: AutoPot emergency disconnect (low HP) — auto-relogin suppressed, press Resume when safe
ws_settings_notification_tooltip: Show popup notification for this link before teleport.
ws_settings_whisper_delay_desc: Delay between whispers for multiple items
radar_setting_huge_map_radius_desc: On huge areas (Sekhema trial floors) draw the radar map only within this grid radius around the player - the full-map draw tanks the FPS. 0 = always draw the whole map. Normal-sized areas are not affected.
atlas_rumour_panel_tooltip: When hovering an expedition island or an uncharted ship on the atlas, show the full community rumour table (rumour, map, mods, rating) beside it. The rows of the hovered destination are highlighted.
atlas_rumour_reset_pos_tooltip: Return the Island Rumours table to automatic placement next to the hovered island.
atlas_rumour_labels_tooltip: Under the name of a fog-of-war expedition island, show its rumour and tier (tier colored by grade), e.g. 'Unknown Ruins  B' under Exhumed Ruins.
signin_prompt_need_account: No account is stored. Sign in with your account through the program at least once (Configuration -> Trade -> Packages), then start the purchase again.
signin_prompt_need_code: The account was emailed a verification code. Enter it in Configuration -> Trade -> Packages to continue.
signin_gateway_explain: The realm gateway the sign-in connects to. Each gateway has its own port, so a host on its own is not enough — pick a row, or add the one your client uses.
signin_gateway_learn_hint: Reads the game's own log and adds every gateway this account actually connected to.
signin_gateway_learn_added: Added {0} gateway(s) from the client log.
signin_gateway_learn_none: No new gateways in the client log.
signin_gateway_learn_nofile: Could not open the client log. Set the game path in the Bot tab first.
signin_gateway_duplicate: That host and port are already in the list.
signin_gateway_invalid: Enter a host and a port between 1 and 65535.
signin_gateway_last_row: The list cannot be emptied — add another gateway first.
signin_gateway_switch_body: Changing the gateway takes effect only on a new sign-in: the current session keeps running through the gateway it connected to. Press OK to disconnect the account now and sign in again on the selected gateway.
signin_gateway_switch_busy: A purchase is running right now — disconnecting will interrupt it.
signin_step_timeout_tooltip: How long one step of the sign-in handshake may stall before the attempt is abandoned. Raise it on a slow connection — set too low, a healthy sign-in is cut off mid-handshake and wastes a reconnect attempt.
signin_panel_intro: Buys over the wire from a signed-in session. No game client is needed — sign in below, then start a search.
signin_learned_hashes: Learned area hashes: {0} ({1} / {2} hideouts and towns)
signin_character_tooltip: Leave blank to choose from the list after signing in.
signin_remember_tooltip: Stored encrypted (DPAPI). Off = nothing is written to disk.
signin_code_prompt: A verification code was emailed to the account - enter it to continue.
trade_session_no_account: no account stored - sign in once in Configuration -> Trade -> Packages
trade_session_need_code: waiting for the emailed code - enter it in Configuration -> Trade -> Packages
trade_session_need_character: waiting for a character to be picked - choose one in Configuration -> Trade -> Packages
trade_session_paused_note: live searches are paused until a character is online again
signin_prompt_need_character: The sign-in is waiting for a character to be picked. Open Configuration -> Trade -> Packages and choose one. If the stored character no longer exists (renamed, deleted, or a new league), pick the new one there and it will be remembered.
trade_safety_reason_not_in_game: trade site session is on a different account, or the game is not running — fix it, then press Resume
trade_safety_reason_invalid_query: the trade site rejected the search query — check the search URL and league, then press Resume
popup_trade_stopped_not_in_game: The trade site says your account must be in-game. The browser session's account does not match the game that is running, or the game is not running at all. All trading has been stopped — fix the session, then press Resume in the Trade tab.
popup_trade_stopped_bad_query: The trade site rejected the search query. The saved search may be for a different league, or it may have expired. All trading has been stopped — fix or remove the search, then press Resume in the Trade tab.
toast_upgrade_already_packet: Your key already includes packet trade — it is unlocked now.
toast_upgrade_key_not_upgradeable: This key cannot be upgraded in its current state.
toast_upgrade_free_session: This session is not eligible for the packet trade subscription.
toast_upgrade_not_connected: No connection to the licence server — try again in a moment.
toast_upgrade_bad_link: The upgrade page link was rejected for safety. Please contact support.
signin_server_table_not_entitled: Server table: not included in your tier
signin_server_table_tooltip: The canonical area table the server distributes to packet-tier sessions. It grows as new areas are learned, and arrives automatically — you do not have to do anything.
hotkey_radar_add_room_desc: Add room target from large map
radar_buffs_gear_tooltip: Configure which buffs and debuffs are shown for this entity type
radar_buffs_hidden_hint: Definitions the game never displays: no icon, no name, or marked invisible. Off for every type by default; shown with a placeholder icon and the internal id.
radar_buffs_radar_size_tooltip: Side of one buff icon on the radar, in screen pixels (8-64).
radar_buffs_game_size_tooltip: Side of one buff icon above the entity in the game view, in pixels (8-64).
radar_buffs_radar_max_tooltip: Icons shown per entity on the radar before the rest collapse into +N (1-16).
radar_buffs_game_max_tooltip: Icons shown per entity in the game view before the rest collapse into +N (1-16).
radar_buffs_read_radius_tooltip: Grid distance from you within which entity buffs are read (20-400). Your own buffs are always read.
radar_buffs_type_off: This type is not shown anywhere: tick Show in the Radar or Game column above.
radar_buffs_value_tooltip: Shows the value the buff grants, read from the entity's stats (e.g. -15% for Elemental Weakness). Curses and exposures are exact; chill and shock show the entity's total.
radar_buffs_show_names_tooltip: Prints each buff's full name above its icon so you can find the one to turn off.
radar_buffs_size_inherit_tooltip: Inherits the type's icon size. Drag or Ctrl+click to set a size for this buff only; set 0 (or anything below 8) to inherit again.
radar_buffs_enabled_tooltip:
When on, the active buffs and debuffs of an entity are drawn as a row of icons.
On the radar the row sits above the entity's icon; in the game view above its health bar.
Which entity types show a row, and which buffs each type shows, is set with the gear beside the type in the table below.
An icon can also carry the remaining time, the value the buff grants and the stack count.
When off nothing is drawn and no entity buff is read from the game at all; every setting here and per type is kept.
radar_buffs_disabled_hint: Buff icons are switched off: tick Enable buff icons on the Icon Management tab. Everything set here is kept and applies the moment you turn it back on.
trade_agent_notready_ready: Agent connected — you can start now.
trade_agent_notready_bridge_stopped: The bridge is stopped, so this program is not connecting to the agent. Start the bridge — it dials the agent host automatically.
trade_agent_newer: Agent newer than this program — update POEFixer
trade_agent_chip_tooltip: Remote-agent connection status. Manage it in Settings -> Trade.
radar_wisps_enabled_tooltip: Draws the Azmeri wisp deposits (Vivid / Primal / Wild / Sacred) on the radar, including sleeping ones at any distance from you. Off: nothing is drawn and the far-away scan is not run.
radar_wisps_scale_tier_tooltip: Bigger deposits get a bigger icon: large 100%, medium 85%, small 70% of the row's size.
healthbar_hidden_paths_hint: Entities whose metadata path contains one of these lines draw no health bar. Case is ignored and a partial path works, so "LeagueRitual/Daemons" hides every ritual daemon. Your own health bar is never hidden.
healthbar_hidden_paths_duplicate: This path is already in the list.
healthbar_hidden_paths_full: The list is full - remove a path before adding another.
healthbar_hidden_paths_empty: The list is empty - every monster draws a health bar.
healthbar_hidden_paths_remove_tooltip: Remove this path from the list
healthbar_hidden_paths_nearby: Monsters around you - click one to hide its kind:
healthbar_hidden_paths_nearby_empty: No monster kinds left to add here.
settings_price_source_tooltip: Where POEFixer takes its prices from. poe.ninja (default) covers currency and unique items; poe2scout is the alternative. Prices reload right after a switch.
settings_price_league_tooltip: Select the league for price data (default: current softcore league).
